column1: #: description: The 95% CL constraints on the long-lived slepton $c\tau_{0}$ and mass. The $\tilde{\tau}$ and co-NLSP limits are shown for the three channels combined
column2: while the $\tilde{e}$ and $\tilde{\mu}$ NLSP limits are shown for the ee and $\mu\mu$ channels
column3: respectively. These limits assume that the superpartners of the left- and right-handed leptons are degenerate in mass and $\mathcal{B}(\tilde{\ell} \to \ell\tilde{G})$ is 100%. The area to the left of the solid curves represents the observed exclusion region
column4: and the dashed lines indicate the expected limits.
